words.ex: He used microfilm to save old newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他使用微缩胶片保存旧报纸。
words.en: Microfilm is a film on which documents or printed materials are photographed at a greatly reduced size for ease of storage.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoons every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通。
words.en: Cartoons are humorous drawings or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or animated films intended for children.

words.ex: He loves reading comics on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看漫画。
words.en: Comics are magazines or books that contain stories told in pictures with speech bubbles or captions.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: He watches a movie every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上都看电影。
words.en: A movie is a story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天弹吉他。
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.ex: He plays the trumpet in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹喇叭。
words.en: A trumpet is a brass musical instrument with a flared bell and three valves, producing a bright, penetrating tone.

words.ex: He plays the flute every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上吹长笛。
words.en: A flute is a musical instrument of the woodwind family. You play it by blowing over a hole at one end while holding it sideways.

words.ex: The children are playing violins in the school orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校管弦乐队中演奏小提琴。
words.en: Violins are bowed string instruments with four strings tuned in perfect fifths. They are the smallest and highest-pitched instruments in the violin family, which also includes the viola, cello, and double bass.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.ex: They went to a music concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A music concert is a performance of music given in public, typically by several performers or of several separate compositions.

words.ex: They went to a music festival last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末去参加了一个音乐节。
words.en: A music festival is a festival oriented towards music that is sometimes presented with a theme such as musical genre, nationality or locality of musicians, or holiday.

words.ex: The restaurant plays soft background music.
words.ex_cn: 餐厅播放轻柔的背景音乐。
words.en: Music that is played quietly in the background to create a particular atmosphere or to accompany another activity.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.ex: They went to the concert hall to hear the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他们去音乐厅听交响乐。
words.en: A concert hall is a building designed for the performance of concerts and other musical events.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.ex: He is a composer who writes music for movies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位为电影作曲的作曲家。
words.en: A composer is a person who writes music, especially classical music.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.tr: n. 图画；绘画；制图； v. 提取；吸引；画；“draw”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child made a drawing of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A drawing is a picture made with a pencil, pen, or crayon rather than paint.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.ex: The movie shows realism by depicting everyday life honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影通过真实地描绘日常生活展现现实主义。
words.en: Realism is the quality or fact of representing a person, thing, or situation accurately or in a way that is true to life.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.ex: He designs graphics for video games.
words.ex_cn: 他为电子游戏设计绘图。
words.en: Graphics are visual images or designs on some surface, such as a wall, canvas, screen, paper, or stone, to inform, illustrate, or entertain.

words.ex: The poem uses symbolism to show love and loss.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗使用象征手法来表现爱与失去。
words.en: Symbolism is the use of symbols to represent ideas or qualities.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: Symbols are marks or signs that represent something else, such as an idea, a quality, or a relationship.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.ex: The global climate conference was held in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 全球气候大会在巴黎举行。
words.en: A conference is a meeting of people who share the same interests or profession.

words.ex: Understanding the culture context helps us know why people behave differently.
words.ex_cn: 理解文化语境有助于我们明白为什么人们行为不同。
words.en: The culture context refers to the background, environment, or setting in which something exists or occurs, especially in terms of the cultural aspects that influence its interpretation or meaning.

words.ex: He learns culture awareness to understand other people.
words.ex_cn: 他学习文化意识以理解他人。
words.en: Culture awareness refers to the understanding and appreciation of the differences and similarities between cultures, which is crucial for effective communication and collaboration in a globalized world.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.ex: He plays chess every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上下棋。
words.en: Chess is a board game for two players, each beginning with 16 pieces of six kinds that are moved according to specific rules, the object being to checkmate the opponent's king.

words.ex: The children are playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上玩耍。
words.en: A playground is an area designed for children to play in, especially at a school or in a park.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.ex: He goes to the health club every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都去健身俱乐部。
words.en: A health club is a place where people go to exercise and improve their physical fitness.

words.tr: phrase. 健身中心；健身场所
words.ex: He goes to the fitness center every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身中心。
words.en: A fitness center is a place where people go to exercise and improve their physical health, typically equipped with various workout machines and offering fitness classes.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: The club has low joining fees for new members.
words.ex_cn: 该俱乐部对新成员收取的入会费很低。
words.en: The amount of money that you have to pay to become a member of a club, organization, or society.

words.tr: n. 会员资格；全体会员；
words.ex: He paid $50 to get membership of the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了50美元以获得健身房的会员资格。
words.en: Membership is the state of being a member of a group or organization.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.ex: He plays baseball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打棒球。
words.en: a game played especially in North America by two teams of nine players, in which a player hits a ball with a bat and tries to run around four bases on a large field before the other team returns the ball

words.ex: He plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末踢足球。
words.en: Soccer is a game played between two teams of eleven players who try to score by kicking or heading a ball into the opposing team's goal.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车； v. 骑自行车；“cycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cycling is good for health.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车对健康有益。
words.en: Cycling is the activity of riding a bicycle, especially as a sport or for pleasure.

words.tr: n. 冲浪运动； v. 冲浪；“surf”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves surfing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末冲浪。
words.en: Surfing is the sport of riding on the top of a wave while standing or lying on a special board.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.ex: He put on his diving mask before jumping into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他跳入海里前戴上了潜水镜。
words.en: A piece of equipment worn over the eyes and nose to enable a person to see clearly underwater.

words.ex: The rescue diver saved the swimmer from the strong current.
words.ex_cn: 救援潜水员从急流中救出了游泳者。
words.en: A rescue diver is a person trained in underwater search and recovery, and in the rescue of individuals in distress in aquatic environments.

words.ex: He wears a wetsuit to swim in cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他穿潜水服在冷水中游泳。
words.en: A wetsuit is a close-fitting garment made of rubber or neoprene, worn by surfers, divers, and others who engage in water sports in cold water, to keep their bodies warm.

words.ex: He loves snowboarding in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在山上滑雪板。
words.en: Snowboarding is a winter sport that involves descending a slope that is covered with snow while standing on a snowboard, a flat board with bindings for the rider's feet.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.ex: He practices judo every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习柔道。
words.en: A sport of unarmed combat derived from jujitsu and intended to train the body and mind. It involves using holds and leverage to unbalance the opponent.

words.ex: He does yoga every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做瑜伽。
words.en: Yoga is a Hindu spiritual and ascetic discipline, a part of which, including breath control, simple meditation, and the adoption of specific bodily postures, is widely practiced for health and relaxation.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: He plays table tennis every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午打乒乓球。
words.en: Table tennis, also known as ping-pong, is a sport in which two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using small rackets.

words.ex: He bought new walking boots for the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他为远足买了新的1058型徒步靴。
words.en: Walking boots are sturdy footwear designed for walking long distances, typically used for hiking or trekking.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.tr: n. 活页练习题；工作记录；工作表
words.ex: The teacher gave the students a worksheet for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们发了一份练习表作为家庭作业。
words.en: A worksheet is a piece of paper on which problems or tasks are set for students or workers to solve or complete.

words.ex: His workload is too heavy this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周的工作量太大了。
words.en: The amount of work to be done by someone, especially in a particular period of time.

words.tr: n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
words.ex: Hard labor helps build strong character.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动有助于培养坚强的品格。
words.en: Work, especially physical work; to work hard.

words.ex: He works hard to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以赚取收入。
words.en: To earn means to gain something, especially money or respect, through your own efforts or work.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: He receives his wages every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: Wages are the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for work that is done manually or in a factory.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.ex: The government provides welfare to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府向贫困家庭提供福利。
words.en: The welfare of a person or group is their health, comfort, and happiness.

words.ex: My parents give me a weekly allowance.
words.ex_cn: 我父母每周给我零用钱。
words.en: An allowance is money that is given regularly, usually to a child, by their parents, or by the government to someone who is unemployed or ill.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: He took sick pay when he had a fever.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧时请了病假工资。
words.en: Sick pay is money paid by an employer to an employee who is unable to work because of illness.

words.ex: He received compensation for his injured leg.
words.ex_cn: 他因腿部受伤获得了赔偿。
words.en: Compensation is something, typically money, awarded to someone in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: He visited the career office to find a job.
words.ex_cn: 他去职业办公室找工作。
words.en: An office that provides advice and information on careers and job opportunities, often within an educational institution.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.tr: phrase. 电话采访；电话面试
words.ex: He did phone interviews for his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他为新工作进行了电话面试。
words.en: A phone interview is a type of job interview conducted over the telephone, often used as an initial screening process.

words.ex: He practiced interview skills before the job interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前练习了面试技巧。
words.en: The abilities and techniques that enable someone to perform well in job interviews, including communication, presentation, and the ability to answer questions effectively.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: He sent his job application yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天寄出了求职申请。
words.en: A document or form that you complete and submit when you are applying for a job.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.tr: phrase. 实习岗位；工作实习安排
words.ex: He did a work placement at a local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家本地医院完成了实习。
words.en: A work placement is a temporary position with an employer, usually arranged by an educational institution, to give students practical experience in a particular field.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.tr: adj. 已退休的；已退职的； v. 退休；“retire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My retired grandfather walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我已退休的爷爷每天早上都在公园散步。
words.en: Having left one's job and ceased to work.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.tr: phrase. 训练不足；培训质量差；不良的培训
words.ex: He failed the test because of poor training.
words.ex_cn: 他因为训练不足而考试失败了。
words.en: Inadequate or insufficient training that leads to poor performance or outcomes.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.tr: phrase. 物质奖励；实物报酬
words.ex: He works hard for material rewards like money and gifts.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作是为了获得金钱和礼物这样的物质奖励。
words.en: Material rewards refer to tangible benefits or compensation given to individuals in recognition of their achievements or contributions, such as bonuses, gifts, or other financial incentives.

words.tr: n. 儿童托管；儿童保育；
words.ex: She works in childcare for young children.
words.ex_cn: 她从事幼儿托管工作。
words.en: The care of children, especially by a service or organization.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.ex: She took maternity leave after her baby was born.
words.ex_cn: 她生完孩子后休了产假。
words.en: A period of absence from work granted to a mother before and after the birth of her child.

words.ex: He tried to persuade her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 人事部门；人力资源部
words.ex: The personnel departments hire new workers.
words.ex_cn: 人事部门招聘新员工。
words.en: The department within an organization that is responsible for hiring, training, and dealing with employees.

words.tr: phrase. 遵循指示；按照说明行事
words.ex: Follow the instructions to turn on the machine.
words.ex_cn: 按照指示打开机器。
words.en: To obey the directions or guidelines given.

words.tr: v. 使可见；使形象化；设想；
words.ex: He uses maps to visualize the data.
words.ex_cn: 他使用地图来使数据可见。
words.en: If you visualize something, you imagine what it is like by forming a mental picture of it.

words.ex: The repetition of the same words made the lesson boring.
words.ex_cn: 相同词语的重复让这堂课变得无聊。
words.en: The act of repeating something that has already been said or written.

words.ex: They make arrangements for the meeting next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们为下周的会议做安排。
words.en: To organize or plan something in advance.

words.tr: phrase. 时间管理；对时间的有效规划与控制
words.ex: He practices time management to finish his homework early.
words.ex_cn: 他练习时间管理，以便早点完成作业。
words.en: The process of planning and exercising conscious control over the amount of time spent on specific activities, especially to increase effectiveness, efficiency, or productivity.

words.ex: He is prioritizing things that matter most.
words.ex_cn: 他正在优先处理最重要的事情。
words.en: Arranging tasks or items in order of importance.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.ex: The children noticed patterns in the tiles on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们注意到了地板瓷砖上的模式。
words.en: Designs or motifs that are repeated in a predictable sequence.

words.ex: Social media trends change quickly.
words.ex_cn: 社交媒体的趋势变化很快。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: The children noticed regularities in the number patterns.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们注意到了数字模式中的规律。
words.en: Regularities refer to the state or quality of being regular, consistent, or uniform in pattern or arrangement.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.tr: n. 建立人际关系网；网络化；
words.ex: He went to the party for networking.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加聚会是为了建立人际关系网。
words.en: The process of interacting with others to exchange information and develop professional or social contacts.

words.ex: He chose self-employment after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他在失业后选择了自主就业。
words.en: Self-employment refers to the state of working for oneself as a freelance or the owner of a business rather than for an employer.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: He received a certificate for completing the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了课程后获得了证书。
words.en: A certificate is an official document attesting a fact, in particular.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.ex: Scientists test many hypotheses to find the truth.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们测试许多假说以寻找真相。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea or explanation for something that is based on known facts but has not yet been proved.

words.tr: phrase. 一般方法；总体方法；通用途径
words.ex: He uses a general approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种通用的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A broad, overall method or strategy for dealing with a subject or problem.

words.ex: Each participant must sign the form.
words.ex_cn: 每个参与者都必须签署表格。
words.en: A participant is someone who takes part in an activity or event.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: He shows examples of good writing.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了优秀写作的例子。
words.en: Instances or samples that illustrate a point, demonstrate a concept, or serve as models.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.tr: n. 小测验；知识竞赛；“quiz”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher gave us five quizzes this week.
words.ex_cn: 老师这周给了我们五次小测验。
words.en: A quiz is a test, game, or competition in which someone answers questions.

words.tr:
n. 试验；测验；
v. 试验；测试；
words.ex: The scientist ran a test to see if the drug works.
words.ex_cn: 科学家进行了一次试验，以查看这种药物是否有效。
words.en: A test is a series of questions or problems that is used to measure a person's ability or understanding of something.

words.tr: n. 活页练习题；工作记录；工作表
words.ex: The teacher gave the students a worksheet for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们发了一份练习表作为家庭作业。
words.en: A worksheet is a piece of paper on which problems or tasks are set for students or workers to solve or complete.

words.tr: phrase. 历年试题；历届试卷；过往考题
words.ex: He practiced with past papers before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前用过去的试卷练习。
words.en: Past papers refer to examination papers from previous years, used by students as a study resource to prepare for upcoming exams.

words.ex: He did revision for his math test last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚为数学考试进行了复习。
words.en: The act or process of revising; a revised or new version, as of a book or other written material.

words.ex: He scans the barcode with a small machine.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小机器扫描条形码。
words.en: A bar code is a pattern of thick and thin black lines that is printed on things you buy. It contains information that a computer can read.

words.tr: n. 时间表；时刻表；课程表；
words.ex: The school publishes a new timetable every term.
words.ex_cn: 学校每学期都会公布新的时间表。
words.en: A timetable is a detailed plan showing the times at which things are intended to happen, especially the times at which particular events or activities are planned to occur.

words.tr: phrase. 小任务；琐碎的工作
words.ex: He finishes small tasks every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上完成小任务。
words.en: Small tasks refer to minor or less significant jobs or assignments that need to be done.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.ex: He makes notes during the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时做笔记。
words.en: To write down information or thoughts, especially in order to remember them or refer to them later.

words.ex: We had a general discussion about the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们对这个项目进行了全面的讨论。
words.en: A general discussion is a conversation or debate about a topic that covers a wide range of issues or aspects, without focusing on specific details.

words.ex: The teacher gave us two case studies to read.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们两个案例研究来阅读。
words.en: Detailed examinations of a subject of study (such as a person, group, or event) over time, especially in business, medicine, or education, to analyze its development or outcomes.

words.tr: phrase. 视觉辅助工具；教学或演示中用于增强视觉效果的物品，如图表、幻灯片或模型
words.ex: The teacher used a chart as a visual aid.
words.ex_cn: 老师用了一张图表作为视觉辅助工具。
words.en: A visual element, such as a diagram, chart, or image, used to clarify or support information.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoons every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通。
words.en: Cartoons are humorous drawings or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or animated films intended for children.

words.ex: The teacher used an overhead projector to show the diagram.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用高射投影机展示图表。
words.en: An overhead projector is a device that projects images or text onto a screen or wall, typically used in classrooms or meetings for presentations.

words.ex: He read the booklet about the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他读了那本关于新规则的小册子。
words.en: A booklet is a small, thin book that has a paper cover and that gives you information about something.

words.ex: He uses a map to find the way.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图找路。
words.en: A map is a visual representation of an area, showing physical features, cities, roads, etc., typically on a flat surface.

words.ex: The teacher gave us simple reading materials for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了简单的阅读材料作为作业。
words.en: Materials intended for reading, such as books, magazines, and other printed or digital content, designed to inform, educate, or entertain.

words.tr: phrase. 旅游宣传册；游客手册
words.ex: The tourist brochure shows the beach and hotels.
words.ex_cn: 这本旅游手册展示了海滩和酒店。
words.en: A tourist brochure is a small book or magazine containing pictures and information about a place, designed to attract tourists.

words.tr: n. 印刷品；讲义；施舍物；救济品；“handout”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher gave out handouts for the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师发了这节课的印刷品。
words.en: Handouts are papers containing information or tasks that are given to people, especially students, to help them learn or understand something.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.ex: He bought a new textbook for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他为数学课买了一本新教科书。
words.en: A textbook is a book containing a comprehensive compilation of content in a branch of study with the intention of explaining it. Textbooks are produced to meet the needs of educators, usually at educational institutions.

words.tr: phrase. 视觉形式；视觉表现形式
words.ex: Charts and graphs are a form of visuals used in presentations.
words.ex_cn: 图表是演示文稿中使用的一种视觉形式。
words.en: A particular type or style of visual representation, such as diagrams, charts, or images.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.ex: He draws charts to show the sales data.
words.ex_cn: 他画图表来展示销售数据。
words.en: A chart is a diagram, picture, or graph which is intended to make information easier to understand. It can also refer to a list that shows the relative popularity of songs, albums, etc.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.tr: n. 数字；人物；体形；“figure”的复数；
words.ex: The figures show a rise in sales this month.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字显示本月销售额有所上升。
words.en: A figure is a number or a person, especially a well-known one. It can also refer to a shape or form, especially that of a person.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找这个词。
words.en: An encyclopedia is a book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.ex: I like to watch movies on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在周末看电影。
words.en: A movie is a film that you watch at a cinema or on television.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.tr: n. 介绍信；参考；引用；提及；“reference”的复数；
words.ex: He gave me three references for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他给我提供了三封介绍信用于这份工作。
words.en: References are mentions of something or someone, or the act of looking at something for information.

words.ex: He sent some attachments with the email.
words.ex_cn: 他通过电子邮件发送了一些附件。
words.en: Attachments are files that are sent along with an email message.

words.ex: He read three articles about history.
words.ex_cn: 他读了三篇关于历史的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or journal. It can also refer to a particular item or object, especially one of a set, or a clause in a legal document.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: He submitted the documentation for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他提交了项目的文件。
words.en: Documentation refers to the act of providing documents or the documents themselves, which serve as evidence or records of something.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.ex: The students filled out questionnaires about their habits.
words.ex_cn: 学生们填写了关于他们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A set of printed or written questions with a choice of answers, devised for the purposes of a survey or statistical study.

words.tr: phrase. 面对面的访谈；当面进行的面试或交谈
words.ex: The company holds face-to-face interviews for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工举行面对面的面试。
words.en: Direct, in-person conversations between two or more people.

words.tr: phrase. 电话访谈；电话面试
words.ex: They did telephone interviews with job applicants.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过电话对求职者进行了面试。
words.en: A telephone interview is a method of conducting job interviews over the phone, often used as an initial screening process.

words.tr: phrase. 数据分析软件，用于处理、分析和可视化数据的计算机程序
words.ex: He uses data analysis software to find patterns in numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他使用数据分析软件来发现数字中的模式。
words.en: Software designed for the examination and interpretation of data to discover useful information, suggest conclusions, and support decision-making.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.ex: The book explains the historical background of the war.
words.ex_cn: 这本书解释了这场战争的历史背景。
words.en: The historical background refers to the events, conditions, or circumstances that are relevant to a particular situation, event, or person in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 进度报告；进展报告；工作汇报
words.ex: He gave his teacher a progress report.
words.ex_cn: 他给老师交了一份进度报告。
words.en: A document that provides information on the current status or development of a project or activity.

words.ex: The company got a lot of publicity from the TV ad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从电视广告中获得了大量宣传。
words.en: Publicity is the activity of making sure that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from the public, especially by providing information about them in newspapers, on television, etc.

words.ex: He made eye contact with the teacher during the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时与老师进行了眼神交流。
words.en: The act of looking directly into someone's eyes as a means of communication or to express interest.

words.ex: He made a gesture of welcome with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手做了一个欢迎的姿态。
words.en: A gesture is a movement that you make with a part of your body, especially your hands, to express emotion or information.

words.ex: The teacher gave a dictation of five sentences.
words.ex_cn: 老师进行了一次五句话的听写。
words.en: Dictation is the speaking or reading aloud of words for someone else to write down.

words.ex: The teacher showed us slides about the solar system.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们展示了关于太阳系的幻灯片。
words.en: Slides can refer to a series of images projected onto a screen or a surface, typically used in presentations, or to a smooth, inclined surface for children to play on by sliding down. As a verb, it means to move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: The lecturer explains math clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这位授课老师讲解数学很清晰。
words.en: A lecturer is a person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The effectiveness of the new medicine was proven in trials.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药的有效性在试验中得到了证实。
words.en: The ability to produce a desired or intended result.

words.ex: The new machine improves the efficiency of production.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器提高了生产的效率。
words.en: Efficiency is the ability to do something or produce something without wasting materials, time, or energy.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.tr: phrase. 处理结果；应对结果
words.ex: He handles results carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他认真处理结果。
words.en: To manage, deal with, or process the outcomes or findings from a task or investigation.

words.tr: phrase. 资源室；资料室；资源教室（学校中为特殊需求学生提供额外教学资源或辅助材料的专用教室）
words.ex: The students use the resources room to find books and computers.
words.ex_cn: 学生们使用资源室查找书籍和电脑。
words.en: A room containing materials or equipment for study or reference.

words.ex: We watch movies in the media room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在多媒体室看电影。
words.en: A room designed for entertainment purposes, equipped with audio and video equipment.

words.tr: phrase. 个体差异；个人差异
words.ex: Each student shows individual difference in learning speed.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生在学习速度上都有个体差异。
words.en: Individual differences refer to the variations or deviations from the average of the group, with respect to the mental or physical characters, occurring in the individual members of the group.

words.ex: He sent his curriculum vitae to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A curriculum vitae is a written account of your education and the jobs you have done, which you send when you are applying for a job.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: He works in marketing for a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司从事营销工作。
words.en: Marketing involves the process of promoting, selling, and distributing a product or service. It includes market research and advertising.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.tr: phrase. 心理因素；心理层面的因素
words.ex: Psychological factors can affect your health.
words.ex_cn: 心理因素会影响你的健康。
words.en: Elements relating to the mind, emotions, and behaviour.

words.ex: He used a colloquialism when he said 'gonna' instead of 'going to'.
words.ex_cn: 他说'gonna'而不是'going to'时，使用了一个口语词。
words.en: A colloquialism is a word or phrase that is used in informal language rather than in formal speech or writing.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.tr: phrase. 电影改编作品；根据小说、戏剧等其他媒介改编的电影
words.ex: He likes film adaptations of classic novels.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢经典小说的电影改编版。
words.en: The process of converting a literary work, such as a novel, into a film, often involving changes to the original material to suit the cinematic medium.

words.ex: The teacher made an intervention to help the student.
words.ex_cn: 老师进行了干预以帮助学生。
words.en: Intervention is the act of intervening, especially in a situation to prevent something undesirable from happening.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.tr: phrase. 数据收集；资料采集
words.ex: The teacher uses data collection to check student progress.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用数据收集来检查学生的进步。
words.en: The process of gathering information or data from various sources for analysis or processing.

words.tr: phrase. 识字率；读写能力比率
words.ex: The literacy rates in this country have improved over the years.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的识字率多年来有所提高。
words.en: The percentage of people in a given population who can read and write.

words.ex: The measurement of temperature is important in science.
words.ex_cn: 温度的衡量在科学中很重要。
words.en: The action of measuring something.

words.ex: His estimation of the situation was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对形势的判断是错误的。
words.en: An estimation is a judgment or opinion about the value, quality, or importance of something, or a calculation of the amount, level, or size of something.

words.tr: phrase. 数据存储；资料储存
words.ex: The phone has enough data storage for all my photos.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有足够的数据存储空间来保存我所有的照片。
words.en: The keeping of data in a computer or on a computer system.

words.tr: phrase. 质量管理；品质控制
words.ex: The factory has strict quality control to make sure products are safe.
words.ex_cn: 工厂有严格的质量管理以确保产品安全。
words.en: Quality control is a process through which a business seeks to ensure that product quality is maintained or improved.

words.tr: phrase. 研究的局限性；研究的限制
words.ex: The study had limitations of study.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究有研究的局限性。
words.en: The term 'limitations of study' refers to the constraints or shortcomings in a research project that may affect the outcomes or conclusions of the study. These limitations can be related to the research design, methodology, sample size, or other factors that could potentially limit the reliability or validity of the study's findings.

words.tr: phrase. 不良事件；有害事件（指在医疗或药物治疗过程中发生的意外或负面反应）
words.ex: The drug caused some adverse events in patients.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物在患者中引起了一些不良事件。
words.en: Unfavorable or harmful occurrences that can happen during a clinical trial or after a drug is on the market.

words.ex: The weather shows a lot of variation in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天天气变化很大。
words.en: A variation is a difference or change in the usual or expected amount, level, or form of something.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.tr: phrase. 文章的长度；论文的篇幅
words.ex: The length of essay must be 500 words.
words.ex_cn: 文章的长度必须是500字。
words.en: The measurement of an essay from beginning to end, usually expressed in words or pages.

words.tr: phrase. 口头陈述；口头报告；口头展示
words.ex: He gave an oral presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的口头报告。
words.en: An oral presentation is a formal, face-to-face speaking method intended to inform, persuade, or build goodwill towards a product, organization, or idea.

words.tr: phrase. 技术术语；专业词汇
words.ex: He uses many technical words in his science report.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学报告中使用了很多专业术语。
words.en: Specialized vocabulary used in a particular field or subject.

words.ex: The study uses a new methodology to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用了一种新的方法论来收集数据。
words.en: A methodology is a system of methods and principles for doing something, for example for teaching or for carrying out research.

words.tr: phrase. 更有组织的；更有条理的
words.ex: He is more organized now than last year.
words.ex_cn: 他现在比去年更有条理了。
words.en: Being more organized means arranging or structuring things in a more systematic and efficient way.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: The contents page shows the chapters and page numbers.
words.ex_cn: 目录页显示了章节和页码。
words.en: A page in a book or document that lists the titles of the chapters or sections and their corresponding page numbers.

words.ex: The teacher asked students to annotate the text with notes.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们在文本上做注释。
words.en: To add notes or comments to a text or diagram, providing explanation or criticism.

words.ex: He wrote a short paragraph about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段关于他假期的短文。
words.en: A paragraph is a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph typically starts on a new line.

words.tr: phrase. 项目符号；要点；提纲
words.ex: He wrote the tasks as bullet points on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他把任务写成了要点列在纸上。
words.en: Bullet points are symbols used to itemize lists or to highlight key points in a text. They are typically small dots or squares, but can also be other symbols.

words.ex: The sequence of numbers is 1, 2, 3, 4.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的顺序是1、2、3、4。
words.en: A sequence is a set of related events, movements, or items that follow each other in a particular order.

words.ex: The book shows page numbers at the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的页码在底部。
words.en: The numbers that are assigned to the pages of a book or document, usually found at the top or bottom of each page, to indicate their order.

words.tr: phrase. 简单的格式化；指不复杂、易于理解或操作的排版或数据组织方式
words.ex: Use simple formatting to make the document easy to read.
words.ex_cn: 使用简单的格式化使文档易于阅读。
words.en: A straightforward and unadorned way of presenting text or data.

words.ex: She added headers and footers to her report.
words.ex_cn: 她在报告中添加了页眉和页脚。
words.en: Headers and footers are sections of a document that appear at the top (header) and bottom (footer) of each page, used to display information such as the document title, author name, page numbers, and dates.

words.tr: n. 打字（或排印）文稿的小错误
words.ex: He found a typo in his email.
words.ex_cn: 他在邮件里发现了一个拼写错误。
words.en: A typo is a mistake in the way something is printed or written.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr: phrase. 清晰地列出想法；条理分明地列举观点
words.ex: He is listing ideas clearly on the board.
words.ex_cn: 他正在黑板上清晰地列出想法。
words.en: Presenting thoughts or points in a clear, organized, and sequential manner.

words.tr: phrase. 过于笼统的；太泛泛的
words.ex: The answer is too general to be useful.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案太笼统了，没有用。
words.en: Lacking specificity or detail.

words.tr: phrase. 复杂的结构；由多个相互关联的部分组成的系统或构造
words.ex: The bridge has complex structures to support heavy trains.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有复杂的结构来承重列车。
words.en: Complex structures refer to systems or arrangements that are composed of interconnected or interwoven parts, making them intricate and often difficult to understand or analyze.

words.ex: He writes long sentences that are hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他写很长的句子，很难理解。
words.en: Sentences that are unnecessarily lengthy and complex.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.ex: We discussed many topics in class today.
words.ex_cn: 今天我们课堂上讨论了很多话题。
words.en: Subjects or themes that are discussed, written about, or studied.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.tr: v. 朝向；前进；“head”的现在分词； n. 标题；
words.ex: The ship is heading north.
words.ex_cn: 船正朝北航行。
words.en: A heading is a word, phrase, or sentence at the beginning of a written passage that explains what it's about.

words.ex: The teacher listed three subtopics for the essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师列出了论文的三个子主题。
words.en: Subtopics are smaller or more specific topics within a larger subject or topic.

words.ex: The book has a short introduction at the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 这本书开头有一段简短的引言。
words.en: The act of presenting something new to someone or something, or the process of making something known or familiar to people.

words.tr: phrase. 统计分析；对数据进行收集、整理、解释和呈现以得出结论的数学方法
words.ex: He did statistical analysis on the survey data.
words.ex_cn: 他对调查数据进行了统计分析。
words.en: The process of collecting, analyzing, interpreting, presenting, and modeling data to uncover patterns and trends.

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.ex_cn: 门上的数字是5。
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.ex: The document uses a clean font.
words.ex_cn: 这个文档使用了一种简洁的字体。
words.en: A font is a set of printable or displayable text characters in a specific style and size.

words.ex: He typed the word in lower case.
words.ex_cn: 他用小写字母盘输入了这个词。
words.en: The form of printed letters that are not capitalized.

words.tr: phrase. 更大的情况；更大的案例；大号箱子
words.ex: The larger case includes more people affected by the policy.
words.ex_cn: 更大的情况包括更多受到该政策影响的人。
words.en: A case that is bigger in size or more significant in importance.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.tr: phrase. 字母之间的空隙；字间距
words.ex: The space between letters is too big in this word.
words.ex_cn: 这个单词中字母之间的间距太大了。
words.en: The gap or interval between individual characters in a piece of text.

words.tr: phrase. 比例间距字体；每个字符宽度按其自然形状比例调整的字体，与等宽字体相对
words.ex: The text uses proportionally spaced fonts for better reading.
words.ex_cn: 这段文字使用了等比间距字体以便于阅读。
words.en: Proportionally spaced fonts are fonts in which the width of the characters varies, allowing for a more even and visually appealing distribution of text.

words.ex: He forgot to use punctuation marks in his sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记在句子中使用标点符号了。
words.en: Punctuation marks are symbols that are used in writing to separate sentences and their elements and to clarify meaning.

words.tr:
v. 缩进排版；使呈锯齿状
n. 订货单
words.ex: Please indent the first line of each paragraph.
words.ex_cn: 请将每段的第一行缩进。
words.en: To start a line of text further from the margin than the main part of the text.

words.tr: phrase. 小号字体；小型字型
words.ex: The book uses a small font for the footnotes.
words.ex_cn: 这本书用小号字体标注脚注。
words.en: Text printed or displayed in a size smaller than the standard.

words.ex: The title is written in bold type.
words.ex_cn: 标题是用粗体字写的。
words.en: Text printed or displayed in a heavier, darker typeface for emphasis.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.ex: The students sat in a row.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐成一排。
words.en: A row is a straight line of things or people. To row means to move a boat through water using oars.

words.ex: The color of the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 天空的颜色是蓝色的。
words.en: Color is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light.

words.tr: 短语动词. 剪切并粘贴文本；指在计算机中将选定的文本从一处移至另一处的操作
words.ex: He cut and pasted text from one document to another.
words.ex_cn: 他把文本从一个文档复制粘贴到另一个文档。
words.en: To move text from one place to another in a document or between documents by cutting it from its original location and pasting it into a new one.

words.tr: n. 清单；检查表；备忘录；目录册；
words.ex: He made a checklist for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行列了一份清单。
words.en: A checklist is a list of items required, things to be done, or points to be considered, used as a reminder.

words.tr: n. 标准；尺度；准则；“criterion”的复数；
words.ex: The main criteria for selection are skill and experience.
words.ex_cn: 选择的主要标准是技能和经验。
words.en: A criterion is a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided.

words.ex: He made a timeline of his school years.
words.ex_cn: 他制作了一个他求学年代的时间表。
words.en: A timeline is a graphical representation of a sequence of events, typically displayed along a line, that shows the timing of each event.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: The skeleton of the dinosaur is displayed in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的骨架在博物馆里展出。
words.en: The internal structure that supports and gives shape to a person, animal, or plant, composed of bones and cartilage in vertebrates.

words.tr: phrase. 理论章节；指书籍或教材中专门阐述理论内容的部分
words.ex: He read the theory chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了理论章节。
words.en: A section of a book or document that deals with theoretical concepts.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.ex: The outcome of the game was a tie.
words.ex_cn: 比赛的结果是平局。
words.en: The outcome of an activity, process, or situation is the situation that exists at the end of it.

words.ex: The fact is that he was late.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他迟到了。
words.en: A fact is a piece of information that is known to be true.

words.ex: He shared his opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这部电影的意见。
words.en: Your ideas or beliefs about a particular subject.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.ex: He submitted his academic record to the university.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的学业成绩提交给了大学。
words.en: A document that provides a detailed account of a student's academic performance, including grades, courses taken, and degrees awarded.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.tr: phrase. 远程学习课程；通过互联网或其他远程方式提供的教育课程
words.ex: He takes distance learning courses at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家上远程学习课程。
words.en: Courses that are conducted remotely, allowing students to learn without being physically present in a classroom.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.tr: phrase. 小组会议；团体讨论
words.ex: We have a group meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周一都有小组会议。
words.en: A gathering of multiple people to discuss topics, share ideas, or make decisions collectively.

words.ex: Math is a compulsory course for all students.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学生的必修课。
words.en: A compulsory course is a subject that students are required to take as part of their curriculum.

words.ex: He follows his daily routine every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循他的日常安排。
words.en: A daily routine is a regular way of doing things in a particular order, especially at the same time each day.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.tr: n. 野外考察；实地调查；
words.ex: The students went on fieldwork to collect soil samples.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去野外考察以采集土壤样本。
words.en: Fieldwork refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.tr: phrase. 特种设备；专用装备
words.ex: The doctor uses special equipment to check the patient.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用特殊设备检查病人。
words.en: Special equipment refers to tools or devices designed for specific tasks or purposes, often not commonly used in everyday activities.

words.ex: The research finding shows that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究发现表明，睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: A research finding is a result or conclusion reached through systematic investigation or study.

words.tr: phrase. 赞成与反对；正面与反面；利弊
words.ex: We listed the pros and cons before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 我们在做决定之前列出了利弊。
words.en: The advantages and disadvantages of something, especially something that you are considering doing.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

chapters.name: Part 4 生态环境机经词汇

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.tr: phrase. 酸度水平；酸性程度
words.ex: The levels of acid in the river are rising.
words.ex_cn: 河流中的酸度水平正在上升。
words.en: The different concentrations or strengths of acid in a solution.

words.ex: The deer is a herbivore.
words.ex_cn: 鹿是食草动物。
words.en: An herbivore is an animal that gets its energy from eating plants, and only plants.

words.ex: Lions are carnivores that eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是吃肉的食肉动物。
words.en: A carnivore is an animal that eats the flesh of other animals.

words.tr: n. 杂食动物；不偏食的人
words.ex: The bear is an omnivore that eats berries and fish.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊是杂食动物，吃浆果和鱼。
words.en: An omnivore is an animal that is able to eat both plants and meat.

words.ex: The variation in salinity affects fish survival.
words.ex_cn: 盐度的变化影响鱼类的生存。
words.en: The change or difference in the salt content of a liquid, such as seawater.

words.tr: phrase. 人造水坝；人工建造的水坝
words.ex: The village built man-made dams to store water.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄建造了人工水坝来储水。
words.en: Barriers constructed by humans to control water flow, often for irrigation, flood prevention, or hydroelectric power.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.tr: n. 化妆品；美容品；“cosmetic”的复数；
words.ex: She buys cosmetics at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 她在药店买化妆品。
words.en: Substances or treatments used to enhance or alter the appearance of the face or body.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: The ozone layer is a layer in the Earth's stratosphere that contains a high concentration of ozone (O3) molecules, which absorb most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

words.ex: The sun position changes during the day.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的位置在一天中会变化。
words.en: The location of the sun in the sky at a particular time and place.

words.ex: We watched the sunset by the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海滩上看了夕阳。
words.en: The time in the evening when the sun disappears or daylight fades.

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.ex: The occupancy of the hotel is high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天酒店的占用率很高。
words.en: The act of occupying or the state of being occupied, especially the condition of being occupied by tenants or the period during which a property is occupied.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.tr: phrase. 回收容器；用于收集可回收物品的垃圾桶或箱子
words.ex: We put plastic bottles in recycling containers.
words.ex_cn: 我们把塑料瓶放进回收箱。
words.en: Recycling containers are designated bins or receptacles for collecting materials that can be recycled, such as paper, glass, metal, and plastic, to reduce waste and conserve resources.

words.ex: He uses soil conditioner to help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他使用土壤改良剂来帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance added to soil to improve its physical properties, especially its ability to provide nutrition for plants.

words.tr: phrase. 办公文具；办公室用品（如纸张、笔、文件夹等）
words.ex: He bought new office stationery for the team.
words.ex_cn: 他为团队买了新的办公文具。
words.en: Office stationery refers to the materials used in an office for writing, such as pens, pencils, paper, and envelopes.

words.ex: The building is made of limestone.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑是由石灰岩建造的。
words.en: Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed largely of the mineral calcite (calcium carbonate: CaCO3).

words.ex: The magnet picks up the iron nail.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁吸起了铁钉。
words.en: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron or steel towards it.

words.ex: The volcanic ash covered the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 火山灰覆盖了附近的城镇。
words.en: Fine particles of rock and mineral ejected into the atmosphere by a volcanic eruption.

words.ex: The waves moved the soft sediment on the sea floor.
words.ex_cn: 海浪移动了海底的软沉积物。
words.en: Soft sediment refers to the accumulation of particles that have settled from suspension in a fluid, typically water, and are not yet compacted into rock.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭垃圾；生活垃圾
words.ex: The city collects domestic waste every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市每周一收集生活垃圾。
words.en: Domestic waste refers to waste material produced in the home environment, including food scraps, packaging, and other materials that are no longer needed.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾填埋场；废物填埋地点
words.ex: The city closed old landfill sites to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 为了减少污染，这个城市关闭了旧的垃圾填埋场。
words.en: Landfill sites are areas of land where waste materials are buried. They are designed to isolate trash from the environment, but they can cause pollution if not managed properly.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: The boat travels through the canal.
words.ex_cn: 船通过运河航行。
words.en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

words.ex: Fish swim among the seagrass near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在岸边的海草间游动。
words.en: Seagrass refers to any of various submerged marine plants with long, narrow leaves that grow in dense groups in shallow coastal waters.

words.tr: phrase. 浅水区；水深较浅的水域
words.ex: The fish swim in shallow waters near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在靠近海滩的浅水区游动。
words.en: Shallow waters are areas of water that are not deep, often found near the shore of a lake, sea, or ocean.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.ex: The water has chemical contaminants from factories.
words.ex_cn: 这种水含有来自工厂的化学污染物。
words.en: Substances that cause pollution by chemical means.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.ex: The government increased transparency about its decisions.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了决策的透明度。
words.en: The condition of being transparent, especially in a way that allows easy understanding or recognition of something.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: The soil has too much moisture.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中有太多湿气。
words.en: Moisture is tiny drops of water in the air, on a surface, or in a substance, that make it feel wet.

words.ex: Water evaporation happens when the sun heats the lake.
words.ex_cn: 当太阳加热湖泊时，水就会蒸发。
words.en: Evaporation is the process by which a liquid turns into a gas.

words.ex: The polar climate is very cold all year.
words.ex_cn: 极地气候全年都非常寒冷。
words.en: A climate characterized by extremely cold temperatures and very little precipitation, found at the Earth's poles.

words.tr: n. 采伐森林；森林开伐；
words.ex: Deforestation is killing many animals.
words.ex_cn: 采伐森林正在杀死许多动物。
words.en: The act of cutting down or burning all the trees in an area.

words.ex: The logging company cuts trees in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这家木材公司在森林里砍伐树木。
words.en: A logging company is a business that cuts down trees for timber.

words.tr: phrase. 云的移动；云层的运动
words.ex: The cloud movements are slow tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚云的移动很缓慢。
words.en: The movement of clouds in the sky, often observed to predict weather changes.

words.ex: He uses an air pump to inflate the bicycle tire.
words.ex_cn: 他用气泵给自行车轮胎打气。
words.en: A device for moving air or gases from one place to another, especially into or out of a confined space.

words.ex: The floodwater covered the road after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，洪水淹没了道路。
words.en: Water that overflows from a river, lake, or ocean onto land that is normally dry, often causing damage.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: The thunderstorm woke us up at night.
words.ex_cn: 雷雨在夜里把我们吵醒了。
words.en: A thunderstorm is a storm with thunder and lightning and typically also heavy rain or hail.

words.ex: He sealed the envelope with glue.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶水把信封封上了。
words.en: A seal is a device or substance that is used to close off or fasten an opening or container, making it airtight or watertight. It can also refer to a marine mammal with flippers for swimming.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his cattle every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的牛。
words.en: Cattle are large domesticated animals that are kept on farms for their milk or meat.

words.ex: The octopus swims quickly in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 章鱼在海里游得很快。
words.en: An octopus is a sea creature with a soft, oval body and eight long arms.

words.tr: n. 鲑鱼；三文鱼；大马哈鱼；
words.ex: He grilled salmon for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他烤了鲑鱼当晚餐。
words.en: A salmon is a large silver-coloured fish which lives in the sea and rivers.

words.ex: He eats tuna for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃金枪鱼。
words.en: A tuna is a large fish that lives in warm seas and is caught for food.

words.ex: Plankton float in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 浮游生物漂浮在海洋中。
words.en: Plankton are the diverse collection of organisms found in water (or air) that are unable to propel themselves against a current (or wind).

words.ex: The dog has parasites in its stomach.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的胃里有寄生虫。
words.en: An organism that lives in or on another organism (its host) and benefits by deriving nutrients at the host's expense.

words.ex: Bears go into hibernation in winter.
words.ex_cn: 熊在冬天冬眠。
words.en: Hibernation is a state of inactivity and metabolic depression in endotherms during winter.

words.tr: phrase. 紫外线辐射水平；指环境中紫外线辐射的强度或剂量
words.ex: The ultraviolet radiation levels are high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的紫外线辐射水平很高。
words.en: The intensity of ultraviolet rays reaching the earth's surface, which can affect human health and the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 石油勘探；石油勘查
words.ex: The company is doing oil exploration in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在沙漠中进行石油勘探。
words.en: The process of searching for oil deposits beneath the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The boat has oil leaks from its engine.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的发动机有漏油。
words.en: Oil leaks refer to the unintended escape of oil from a container or system, which can lead to environmental pollution and other hazards.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.ex: Washing hands kills germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死细菌。
words.en: Germs are very small organisms that cause disease.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: The fungus grows on old trees.
words.ex_cn: 真菌生长在老树上。
words.en: A fungus is a simple type of plant that has no leaves or flowers and that grows on plants or decaying matter.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.tr: phrase. 化学特征；化学标识（用于识别物质或过程的独特化学成分或模式）
words.ex: The soil has a unique chemical signature.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤具有独特的化学特征。
words.en: A chemical signature is a unique set of chemical characteristics that can be used to identify a substance or material.

words.tr: phrase. 被污染的场所；受污染的场地
words.ex: The contaminated site was cleaned by the government.
words.ex_cn: 这个被污染的地点由政府进行了清理。
words.en: A contaminated site refers to a location where the soil, groundwater, or surface water has been polluted by hazardous substances, making it unsafe for certain uses without remediation.

words.tr: phrase. 识别模式；辨认出规律
words.ex: Children learn to identify patterns in numbers.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们学习识别数字中的模式。
words.en: To recognize and name particular patterns or trends in data or behavior.

words.ex: Penguins live at the south pole.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅生活在南极。
